FEATURED BRAND

MARIGOLD

MARIGOLD Fruit Drinks comes in four flavours: Apple, Orange, Mango and Grape. The range is enriched with Vitamins A, B, C, D & E, contains no preservatives and sits within MARIGOLD’s Halal-certified product portfolio.

Enriched with Vitamins A, B, C, D & E.No preservatives.MARIGOLD products are Halal-certified.
